title: The difference between Shot with IMAX and Filmed for IMAX - Engadget
summary: A movie can be both “Filmed for IMAX” and shot with IMAX cameras, which is why the two labels are easy to confuse. "Shot with IMAX" and "Filmed for IMAX" sound like two ways of saying the same thing.
